artist.name: Rosalía (3)
artist.profile:
Rosalia Vila Tobella (born 25 September 1992, in Sant Cugat del Vallès, Barcelona), known mononymously as Rosalía, is a Spanish singer, songwriter, producer, actress and musician.
She has become known for her modern approach of flamenco music and for her genre-bending musical styles, evolving from folk to the mainstream and avant-pop.
